format:

About 10 minutes, **anonymous**, and every question is optional. Ratings are summarised for everyone on the [public summary page](feedback-summary.html); written comments and questions appear there only after review, **never with names**, and sorted alphabetically so nobody can tell who wrote what.

[See what participants said](feedback-summary.html){.btn .btn-primary} [Paper version (PDF)](feedback-form.pdf){.btn .btn-outline-secondary}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
config = fetch("feedback-config.json", {cache: "no-store"})
  .then(r => r.ok ? r.json() : ({})).catch(() => ({}))
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  const url = (config.form_embed_url || "").trim();
  if (!url) return html`<div class="callout callout-style-simple callout-note"><div class="callout-body">
    The online form opens at the workshop. Until then, please use the
    <a href="feedback-form.pdf">paper version</a>.</div></div>`;
  const open = url.replace("?embedded=true", "");
  return html`<p class="small">Form not showing? <a href="${open}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open it in a new tab ↗</a></p>
    <iframe src="${url}" title="Workshop feedback form" style="width:100%; height:2400px; border:0;" loading="lazy">Loading…</iframe>`;
}
```
